nodes.label: Skill routing reaches 2 of 31 skills - the rules are dead on case
nodes.blockedBy: a case bug: skill(forBoundary:) lowercases the path at line 54 and then applies case-sensitive uppercase patterns at lines 24-27
nodes.evidence: Read in full today. rings/SR-00/QueenSkillMatch.swift:54 `let lower = path.lowercased()` then :55 `rules.first(where: { $0.matches(lower) })`. The rules at :24-27 include `$0.hasSuffix("Tests.swift")`, `$0.hasSuffix("Makefile")` and `$0.contains("rings/RUST-")` - none can ever match a lowercased string. Only tests/, build.sh and .swift survive, so e2e-testing and agent-safe-build are the only reachable skills of 31 installed. A rings/RUST- boundary matches nothing, hits `guard let match ... else { return nil }` and gets NO skill.

nodes.label: Mac -> cloud address and token: registry mirror and lease contention
nodes.blockedBy: an unpaid operator secret - neither app bundle carries TRIOS_AGENT_SERVER_URL or TRIOS_QUEEN_LEASE_URL, so the mirror never publishes and the Mac never contends
nodes.evidence: Measured on the running app (pid 41623): `ps -Eww | grep '^TRIOS_'` returns nothing, and PlistBuddy on trios.app and trios-dev.app lists only TRIOS_A2A_PORT, TRIOS_CANARY_MCP_PORT, TRIOS_VARIANT, TRIOS_MCP_PORT, TRIOS_MESH_PORT. So ProjectPaths.agentServerIsRemote is false (:197-199), QueenDelegationRegistry.swift:717 returns at its guard, and QueenLease.endpoint is nil so acquire returns .uncontested (QueenLease.swift:39-44). The tick then refuses at queen-tick.ts:231-235 with 'no registry mirror published yet'. `grep -n TRIOS_AGENT_SERVER_URL build.sh` returns nothing.
nodes.note: QueenLease.swift:31-37 names the consequence itself: 'an unconfigured Mac standing beside a running cloud tick is two Queens - and this case is what that looks like from here.' Deliberate per CLOUD-MIGRATION.md:546-561: 'the address goes in when the token does, in that order.'

BRANCH PUBLICATION OUT OF THE CONTAINER. CLOUD-MIGRATION.md:124-128 says the transfer does not exist and that QueenDelegationPolicy.unpublishableWorkRefusal therefore refuses remote delegations; the tree implements it at rings/SR-01/QueenGitExecutor.swift:405 (format-patch out, git am --3way in), wired at QueenBranchCommitter.swift:281, and canPublish at :378 is `executor.isLocal || executor.repositoryRoot != nil` so the refusal cannot fire remotely at all. SOURCE HEADER VS SOURCE. queen-tick.ts:21-25 says 'WHAT THIS LOOP DOES NOT DO: start the bee ... the dispatch path is still driven from the app' and line 354-366 calls dispatchBee. CLOUD-MIGRATION.md carries the same stale claim at :361 and self-corrects at :850 with a measured dispatch. The document is chronological and honest; the source header is simply wrong now.

MISSION AND BEE CONTRACTS. RELEASE-BLOCKER.md:32-34 says they are 'absent - nothing in rings/, no .trinity/missions'; rings/SR-00/QueenMissionContract.swift and QueenBeeResult.swift exist with tests. Resolution: half the doc is false (the types exist), half is still true (.trinity/missions does not exist and there is no production caller - confirmed today by grep). Written and tested, unwired.

MESH SUBMODULE LAW VS PRACTICE. rings/RUST-13/trios-mesh/CLAUDE.md forbids 'writing .rs files by hand for any business logic (crypto, mesh, routing, wire format)'; src/lib.rs:3-5 excludes the 68 generated files from compilation and the four modules that ship - crypto.rs, router.rs, routing.rs, wire.rs - are exactly those four forbidden categories, hand-written.

ASCII PURITY. The ascii-lint skill, .trinity/specs/ascii-purity.md:4 and AGENTS.md:154 all assert ASCII-only source; measured today, 37 of 206 Swift files and 5 of 31 SKILL.md files violate it and no gate exists in Makefile, build.sh or any workflow. staleSkills.staleClaim: Instructs `# prod\n./build.sh` and `TRIOS_VARIANT=staging cargo run --bin clade-build`. Bare ./build.sh builds DEV (build.sh:19), build.sh:32 hard-rejects 'staging', .worktrees/staging does not exist, and clade-build defaults to prod and would overwrite the running trios.app.
staleSkills.shouldSay: Rewrite around `make dev`, `make check`, `make release`. Delete every clade-build and staging reference. Highest priority in the library: this is one of only three skills QueenSkillMatch names, so a stale build recipe is on the one live routing path to a worker.

staleSkills.staleClaim: Steps 1 and 2a run `cargo run --bin clade-build` (defaults to prod, replaces trios.app); step 2b runs `git add -A && git commit`; clade-health reads .trinity/snapshots/, which does not exist on this machine.
staleSkills.shouldSay: Use `make doctor` / `make dev` / `make check`; commit by pathspec, never `git add -A` in a repository several agents share; drop or gate the snapshot read. The model pin (claude-sonnet-4-6) is the one part still valid.

staleSkills.staleClaim: 'Ensures all trios source, build, policy, agent and skill files stay ASCII-only.'
staleSkills.shouldSay: Either state the measured reality (37 of 206 Swift files and 5 of 31 SKILL.md files carry non-ASCII, and no gate exists anywhere) and build the check, or retire the law and amend .trinity/specs/ascii-purity.md:4 and AGENTS.md:154 with it. Do not leave a rule asserted in three places and measured in none.

Say that the gate exists at rings/RUST-99/tmp-zero-gate, does not exempt clade-e2e, would fail today, and is invoked by no target - then wire it into `check:` or exempt clade-e2e deliberately.
